integrity: The proof is an exact conditional-Gaussian induction. No numerical experiment, finite enumeration, asymptotic extrapolation, or external certification is used as proof.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for real independent-entry symmetric Gaussian hafnians and moments through order four. It does not assert equality in law with Gaussian Pfaffians for orders at least three, exact density peaks, higher moments, or finite-row Gram analogues.
title: Fourth-moment universality between real Gaussian hafnians and Pfaffians
